column1: ## Repository Table R17. HAQER illustration track values

## Description: Reader-facing values and intervals for the Fig. 4e tracks. Coordinates are hg38, zero-based half-open for intervals. Numeric scores and categorical annotations retain their distinct meanings.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | HAQER identifier | HAQER identifier for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 2 | Assembly | Assembly for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Chromosome | Chromosome for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 4 | Track | Track for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 5 | Record type | Record type for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 6 | Position | Position for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 7 | Interval start | Beginning of the stated genomic interval; coordinates follow the table-specific convention.
## Column 8 | Interval end | End of the stated interval or recorded range; interval convention is stated above.
## Column 9 | Summit | Summit for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 10 | Value | Value for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 11 | Annotation | Annotation for the observation defined in the table description.
